info.name: CYCLES_GEOMETRY_SUBDIVISION
info.comment: Cycles vendor extension: Catmull-Clark / linear subdivision surfaces on 'triangle' and 'quad' geometry. Primitives become Cycles subdivision base faces and are adaptively diced at render time using an object-space metric: patch edges are split until shorter than 'subdivisionDicingRate' object-space units, capped at 2^'subdivisionLevel' segments per edge (lower rate or higher level = more detail and memory). Catmull-Clark evaluates the OpenSubdiv limit surface and computes smooth normals itself, so user-supplied normals/tangents are ignored while subdivision is active. Optional edge creases sharpen the limit surface: 'primitive.creaseIndex' holds vertex-index pairs and 'primitive.creaseWeight' one weight in [0,1] per pair (1 = fully sharp). Off by default ('subdivision'='none') with zero overhead.

parameters.name: subdivision
parameters.description: subdivision scheme applied to the base primitives

parameters.name: subdivisionLevel
parameters.description: maximum subdivision level: adaptive dicing is capped at 2^level segments per patch edge (clamped to [0,16])

parameters.name: subdivisionDicingRate
parameters.description: adaptive dicing rate: target diced edge length in object-space units (smaller = finer tessellation)

parameters.name: primitive.creaseIndex
parameters.description: vertex-index pairs naming creased edges of the base mesh

parameters.name: primitive.creaseWeight
parameters.description: one crease weight in [0,1] per creaseIndex pair (1 = fully sharp edge)
